title: How to organise the seasonal and guest zone | Hall Closet
description:
Parks the things you use a few weekends a year: guest bedding, decorations, and travel gear.

This is the Seasonal and Guest Zone in the Hall Closet. About 45-75 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Three or four lidded bins on the upper shelf, each labeled with what is inside and the month it was last closed. Guest pillows sealed in a zip bag. A shelf map taped inside the door showing which bin sits where, and nothing overhead heavy enough to need both hands.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Every lid comes off, on the floor, in daylight.
Straighten: One bin per occasion, not one bin per overflow.
Shine: Guest bedding gets washed before it goes into the bin rather than after it comes out, because a year sealed in
Safety: A heavy lidded bin lifted down from above your head is how ankles and backs go, especially when the lid blocks
Standardize: Every bin carries its contents and the date it was last closed.
Sustain: Taking the guest bed apart after a visit sends the bedding to the wash and then straight back into its own lab

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Every bin is lidded, labeled with contents and the date it was last closed, photographed inside the lid, and stored clean and dry.
